en: Sepia-toned photographic postcard showing a powerful waterfall in a rocky river gorge. In the background there is a long truss bridge crossing the river and low mountains or mesas beyond. The foreground has rough rock formations and some wooden or metal structures near the water's edge. Handwritten white text appears along the bottom margin, including a location label on the left and a photographer's credit and date on the right.
